seen.out/storytime-review/batch-34/brief.md: Batch 34 brief: 10 rows, bar 7.0, goal per row, line-art rule, batch 32 defects to recheck. Daniel's new bar section added on top.
seen.out/storytime-review/batch-34/refs/out_s: Nan look reference: black hair in two bunches with red bands, orange T-shirt with white star, red shorts, cream sneakers, large dark-brown eyes with a small eyelash mark at each outer corner.

Cast group A: Pat (black spiky hair, green shirt, brown shorts, holds brown bear), May (black ponytail, yellow star clip, yellow shirt, blue skirt), Sam (brown hair, red-white striped shirt, blue shorts), Mia (light hair, pink clip, pink shirt, blue overalls).

Cast group B: Ben (tan curly hair, blue shirt and shorts), Nan, Teacher Kim (dark hair in low ponytail, sage cardigan, cream shirt, navy trousers), Pip (golden-brown puppy, cream muzzle and forehead stripe, red collar with gold tag).
seen.out/storytime-review/muse-cast/teacher-k: Teacher Kim sheet: adult woman, dark brown hair in a low ponytail, sage green cardigan over cream collared shirt, navy trousers, brown shoes, no glasses.
